channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas lidera disputa ao governo de SP, diz pesquisa
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads the race for governor of São Paulo in both scenarios tested by the Real Time Big Data poll from June 2026. Fernando Haddad remains in second place, reflecting the ongoing divide between the incumbent and the opposition. The survey interviewed 2,000 people, has a 2-point margin of error, and is registered with the TSE under code SP-09734/2026.

item.title: Flávio tem 47% contra 44% de Lula em SP no 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll shows that, in a hypothetical 2026 runoff in São Paulo, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) leads President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) with 47% to 44%, within the 2-point margin of error, indicating a technical tie. In the first round, Bolsonaro has 36% and Lula 31%. The survey also reveals high rejection rates: 51% would not vote for Lula, 50% for Bolsonaro, and 47% for Aécio Neves, while Lula’s government is disapproved by 53% of São Paulo voters.

item.title: Tarcísio é aprovado por 62% e reprovado por 34%, diz pesquisa
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) has a 62% approval rate and 34% disapproval among state voters, according to a Real Time Big Data poll released on June 16, 2026. The survey, conducted June 13–15 with 2,000 respondents, found 41% rated his government as 'excellent/good' and 23% as 'bad/terrible'. The poll carries a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Jornalista perseguido por Carla Zambelli paga multa, e Justiça revoga prisão e encerra processo
item.description: São Paulo’s justice system revoked the open-regime arrest order against journalist Luan Araújo after he paid a R$ 2,216.30 fine, raised through an online fundraising campaign. The ruling ends the defamation and injuria lawsuit filed by former deputy Carla Zambelli, who accused him of insulting her in a article criticizing her 2022 incident of pointing a gun at him during the elections. Araújo’s defense celebrated the outcome as a victory of popular solidarity, stressing the disproportionality of the penalty given his financial vulnerability.

item.title: CNC aciona STF contra medida de Lula que zerou a "taxa das blusinhas"
item.description: The CNC filed an ADI before the STF challenging Lula’s provisional measure that eliminated the federal tax on international purchases up to US$50, known as the 'blusinhas tax,' claiming it creates unfair competition and harms domestic commerce. The action argues the measure, enacted without genuine urgency, advantages imports and threatens local jobs and development. The CNI had previously filed a similar ADI on May 22, reflecting broad sectoral opposition to the tax policy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula estão tecnicamente empatados no 2º turno em SP, diz RealTime/Big Data
item.description: A RealTime/Big Data poll released on Tuesday, the 16th, shows a technical tie between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 presidential election runoff in São Paulo. Both candidates are within the poll's margin of error, indicating a highly competitive race in Brazil's most populous state.

item.title: Lula se reúne com primeira-ministra do Japão no G7 e diz que Mercosul pode iniciar negociações de acordo comercial com o país
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced that Mercosul and Japan may begin negotiations for a trade agreement this month, with a formal announcement expected at the bloc’s summit on June 30 in Asunción. The statement was made during a bilateral meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on the sidelines of the G7 summit, where Lula emphasized historical ties and Brazil’s strategy to expand Mercosul’s trade agreements. Japan also supports the initiative, seeking to resume formal talks amid global trade restructuring.

item.title: Deputado evita colocar lenha na fogueira em crise entre Zema e cúpula do Novo de SC
item.description: Federal deputy Gilson Marques avoided commenting on the internal crisis within Novo between Romeu Zema and the party's leadership in Santa Catarina, stating he is focused on defeating the PT and does not wish to fuel internal or right-wing conflicts. The Catarina leadership of Novo uninvited Zema from an event after his criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro, threatening to withdraw support unless there are immediate changes in his campaign's communication team. Despite the tension, Zema advocates for right-wing unity in a potential second round against the PT.

item.title: Lula e o bloqueio orçamentário das Forças Armadas
item.description: Defense Minister José Múcio Monteiro held an extra-agenda meeting with President Lula over the weekend to discuss a R$ 4,363 billion budget blockade affecting the Ministry of Defense — the largest in absolute terms across all ministries on the Esplanade. The cut directly impacts the Armed Forces, raising concerns about operational and logistical capabilities. The report is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Encontro de Lula e Trump ainda não está na agenda
item.description: A meeting between Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Donald Trump is not currently scheduled for the G7 Summit in Évian-les-Bains, France. Although both leaders are present at the event, there is no planned bilateral meeting, according to officials monitoring Brazil-U.S. relations, who say it is unlikely to change.

item.title: Haddad diz que eram governadores que cobravam taxa das blusinhas
item.description: Fernando Haddad stated that governors, not the federal government, initiated the 'blusinhas tax' on international purchases under US$ 50, and defended the measure as correct and consensual. He emphasized it was approved unanimously by Congress and was not a partisan initiative, despite being backed by Lula’s economic team. The claim was challenged by Community Notes on X, which noted that Haddad, as finance minister, was responsible for implementing the tax.

item.title: Oposição não sabe o que fazer com a candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the Liberal Party's presidential candidate, faces an electoral trust crisis after revelations that he requested 134 million reais from Daniel Vorcaro, the former owner of Banco Master, accused of billion-dollar frauds. Despite being Lula's main rival in polls, he leads in rejection, with 56% of women and 48% of men saying they would 'never' vote for him, primarily due to distrust over his ties to Vorcaro. The situation is unprecedented: the opposition does not know how to handle his candidacy, as most independent voters and even a segment of non-Bolsonarist right-wingers believe he knew about the corruption involving Banco Master.

item.title: Lula tem 48,1% e Flávio, 42,9%, em eventual 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff with 48.1% to 42.9%, according to a Futura/Apex poll released on June 16, 2026. The survey also shows the president ahead of the senator in multiple first-round scenarios. The poll interviewed 2,000 people, has a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points, and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Congresso é desaprovado por 58,8% e aprovado por 29,8%, diz pesquisa
item.description: The National Congress is disapproved by 58.8% of Brazilians and approved by 29.8%, according to a Futura/Apex poll conducted June 8–12, 2026, with 2,000 respondents across 861 municipalities. The STF (Supreme Federal Court) also shows negative perception, with 51.1% disapproval and 38.3% approval. The survey, registered with the TSE under BR-01461/2026, has a 2.2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Lula tem 48,1%, contra 42,9% de Flávio no segundo turno, diz pesquisa Apex/Futura
item.description: Lula leads with 48.1% voting intentions against 42.9% for Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical second-round scenario, according to the Apex/Futura poll released on Tuesday. Lula's advantage stands at 5.2 percentage points, maintaining his lead in the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: De Sarney aos Bolsonaro, passando por Cunha e Tarcísio, o oportunista agora é Negão
item.description: The article traces a trajectory of political opportunism in Brazil, from José Sarney to figures like Eduardo Cunha, Tarcísio de Freitas and Jair Bolsonaro, culminating in the claim that the new 'opportunist' is influencer Negão. It criticizes the repetition of behavioral patterns that prioritize personal gain over the common good, especially during economic and institutional crises.

item.title: Vantagem de Tarcísio sobre Haddad vem do interior, indica pesquisa
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading Fernando Haddad in the São Paulo gubernatorial race, driven mainly by strong support in the state's interior. While Haddad ties with Tarcísio in the capital and metropolitan area (39% to 38% and 39% to 39%, respectively), the governor holds a commanding lead elsewhere, exceeding 30-point margins in some regions. Other candidates, including Kim Kataguiri and Paulo Serra, remain marginal, with support below 11% across all areas.

item.title: Força eleitoral de Tarcísio está no interior de SP, indica Realtime
item.description: The Realtime Big Data poll released on Tuesday, the 16th, shows that Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), a pre-candidate for re-election, has his electoral strength concentrated in the interior of São Paulo. His main rival, former Minister Fernando Haddad (PT), is more competitive in the capital and metropolitan region but significantly trails in the interior. The survey highlights the territorial polarization between the two candidates in the 2026 elections.

item.title: A disputa pela presidência entre os eleitores de SP, segundo o Real Time Big Data
item.description: According to a Real Time Big Data poll among São Paulo voters, Flávio Bolsonaro leads the first round with 36% versus Lula's 31%, though both are technically tied in a potential runoff at 47% to 44%. Lula's government approval stands at 43%, with 53% disapproval.

item.title: No G7, Lula discute acordo Mercosul-Japão com 1ª ministra japonesa
item.description: President Lula met with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on the sidelines of the G7 in Évian-les-Bains to discuss a potential Mercosul-Japan trade agreement, expressing optimism about its progress ahead of the bloc’s June 30 meeting. He also raised concerns with European officials regarding the EU’s veto on Brazilian beef exports due to missing documentation on veterinary drug controls. Later, Lula addressed the G7’s expanded session on international partnerships, criticizing reduced global development aid and urging wealthy nations to support poorer countries.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio aciona TCU e acusa governo Lula de pedalada fiscal na gestão do BPC
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, filed a complaint with the TCU accusing the Lula government of committing a 'fiscal pedalada' in the management of the BPC, alleging the postponement of mandatory expenses in 2025 through the suspension of automatic concessions by INSS, which allegedly caused 740 thousand pending cases and manipulated the fiscal result. He requests an operational and compliance audit of INSS, MDS, and Dataprev, investigation of budget underestimation, and accountability of public officials involved.

item.title: Os desafios de Lula no G7 para não ficar escanteado em meio ao foco em crises globais e embate entre Trump e Europa
item.description: Lula faces the challenge of not being sidelined at the G7, where discussions are dominated by global crises such as the war in Ukraine and trade tensions between Trump and Europe. The simultaneous presence of Lula and Trump at the same event raises expectations for direct negotiations over a potential new U.S. tax on Brazilian imports, a sensitive issue for Brazil’s economy. Lula seeks to assert his role as a leader of the Global South while navigating domestic and external pressures.

item.title: Com Bolsonaro preso, campanha de Flávio aposta em legado do pai e reedita estratégia usada pelo PT com Lula em 2018
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is attempting to keep his father Jair Bolsonaro's image central in his 2026 campaign through archival footage, jingles, and AI-generated content, as the former president is under house arrest and barred from social media. The strategy mirrors the PT's approach in 2018, when Fernando Haddad campaigned as Lula's political successor during his imprisonment. Flávio aims to position himself as the natural heir of Bolsonarism, strengthening emotional ties with conservative voters through symbols, rituals, and continuity narratives.

item.title: O dilema dos independentes
item.description: The 2026 presidential runoff will hinge on either the unification of the right around Flávio Bolsonaro or Lula’s ability to win over independent centrist voters — yet both scenarios are deemed uncertain, as Lula appears poised to radicalize his campaign and right-wing unity remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Gestão Trump monitora desdobramentos de escândalo Vorcaro no Brasil
item.description: The U.S. government is monitoring the Vorcaro scandal involving the Master scheme, assessing it could cause more damage to Brazilian politics and judiciary than any American measures. Their focus includes STF investigations, the failed plea bargain attempt by Vorcaro, his alleged ties to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, and Minister Alexandre de Moraes — who was previously sanctioned by the Trump administration.

item.title: O cálculo de Lula ao não pedir uma reunião com Donald Trump na França
item.description: President Lula chose not to request an official meeting with Donald Trump during the G7 summit in France, opting for a 'damage reduction' strategy to avoid unnecessary confrontations or diplomatic strain amid global tensions. The decision reflects a careful political calculation, prioritizing international stability without provoking controversy with the former U.S. president.

item.title: Ex-presidente do Banco dos Brics ganha espaço entre conselheiros de Flávio na economia ao lado de nomes ligados ao governo Bolsonaro
item.description: Former president of the New Development Bank (BRICS Bank), Marcos Troyjo, has been consulted by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on economic policy proposals, particularly regarding international trade and external affairs. Though not part of the formal pre-campaign structure, Troyjo is valued for his international experience and market connections. Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa Econômica Federal, is also directly involved in shaping the senator’s economic program.

item.title: Distante de Flávio, Michelle Bolsonaro vive relação de atritos com campanha presidencial do PL; relembre
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro maintains a tense relationship with the presidential campaign of her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, demanding a public apology to join the effort. The rift stems from Flávio's public criticism of her as 'authoritarian' and her support for Eduardo Girão over Ciro Gomes in Ceará. Despite PL's efforts to bring her in, Bolsonaro's sons show no willingness to meet her condition.

item.title: Após atrito de Zema e Flávio, Novo de SC diz que será contra campanha do ex-governador caso não haja 'mudança drástica'
item.description: Santa Catarina’s Novo party warned it may oppose Romeu Zema’s presidential bid unless his communication team undergoes a drastic and immediate change, amid growing tensions with the Bolsonaro family. The party also uninvited Zema from a July event in the state, stressing the need for right-wing unity over leadership disputes. The rift complicates ongoing talks for a PL-Novo alliance in Brazil’s South, where Novo’s Adriano Silva is slated to be Jorginho Mello’s running mate.

item.title: O GLOBO lança newsletter com análises e bastidores do STF
item.description: O GLOBO launches the newsletter 'Recondo e os Onze', written by journalist and researcher Felipe Recondo, offering weekly accessible analyses of the STF without legal jargon. The publication aims to explain the inner workings, rulings, and internal disputes of Brazil's Supreme Court to a general audience. This initiative is part of the newspaper's expanded political coverage ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Apontado como ex-chefe do PCC e CV pelos EUA, brasileiro mantinha esposa em cárcere e tentava fuga para o México
item.description: Brazilian national Felipe Linares De Oliveira Dell Aquilla, alias 'Don', was arrested in the U.S. after attempting to flee police, with American authorities identifying him as a former leader of the PCC and CV criminal factions. His wife confirmed during interrogation that she had been held in private captivity, and authorities seized multiple phones, laptops, cash, and a 9mm pistol from his vehicle. Aquilla was already subject to an Interpol red notice issued by Brazil on charges of criminal association and extortion.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro enfrenta resistência para transformar aliados em cabos eleitorais no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces resistance from allies in the Northeast to become active electoral campaigners, despite the PL's strategic alliances in the region. Local leaders avoid explicit commitment due to the PT's strong historical performance in the region, where Lula won 69.3% of the vote in 2022. Polls show Lula maintains a significant lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in the Northeast, both in the first and second rounds, hindering the Bolsonaro campaign in the region.

item.title: STF julga nesta terça acusação contra Eduardo Bolsonaro por coação em processo sobre tentativa de golpe em 2022
item.description: The STF will rule this Tuesday on whether Eduardo Bolsonaro is guilty of obstruction of justice, accused of seeking U.S. government pressure to influence Brazilian Supreme Court ministers and prevent Jair Bolsonaro’s conviction in the 2022 coup plot. Conviction carries a 1–4 year prison sentence and potential ineligibility. The Public Defender’s Office argues for dismissal due to procedural flaws or lack of evidence.

item.title: Primeira turma do STF julga Eduardo Bolsonaro por atuação nos EUA e tentativa de coagir magistrados
item.description: The First Chamber of the Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) begins the trial of Eduardo Bolsonaro for procedural coercion and seeking U.S. sanctions against the Brazilian judiciary. Relator Alexandre de Moraes will read the report, followed by arguments from the Prosecutor General’s Office and the Public Defender’s Office, with a vote expected from all chamber members. The case underscores the Court’s stance against foreign interference, particularly following U.S. sanctions tied to the Magnitsky Act and the Trump administration.

item.title: Acordo para o fim da guerra no Oriente Médio leva governo Lula a prever alívio na inflação e nos juros
item.description: The Lula administration views the U.S.-Iran preliminary agreement as an opportunity to ease inflationary pressure in Brazil through potential oil price relief. A 60-day ceasefire could normalize supply via the Strait of Hormuz, pushing Brent below $80 and partially reversing inflation and interest rate projections. This may allow the Central Bank to continue cutting the Selic rate, albeit cautiously due to uncertainty over the peace's durability.

item.title: Decisão do STF sobre eleições do Rio pode ficar para depois do recesso
item.description: The STF's discussion on Rio de Janeiro's supplementary elections, following Cláudio Castro's conviction for abuse of political and economic power, may be postponed until August after the judicial recess, as it awaits the conclusion of the TSE proceedings, including the publication of the ruling and the deadline for appeals. The STF's decision could shape the format of the interim mandate election and serve as a gauge of tensions between the Court and the TSE ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Diante de Trump, Lula deve criticar protecionismo dos EUA na reunião de hoje do G7, na França
item.description: President Lula is expected to criticize U.S. protectionism, particularly the threatened 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, during his participation in the G7 summit in France. He aims to reinforce multilateralism, position Brazil as the voice of the Global South, and strengthen alliances with countries like Japan and Switzerland to counter U.S. trade measures and explore alternative markets.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: Câmara deve votar hoje projeto de lei com o mesmo texto da PEC
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies is set to vote today on a bill to end the 6x1 work schedule, using the same text as the PEC already approved in the House, under constitutional urgency. The move aims to unblock the plenary agenda, stalled since May 30, after the government rejected House Speaker Hugo Motta’s request to remove the urgency. Though prioritized by the Lula administration, the proposal remains pending in the Senate, where President Davi Alcolumbre has not yet referred it to the Constitution and Justice Committee.

item.title: Caiado diz que Flávio "perdeu a condição" de vencer Lula nas eleições
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) claims that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) has 'lost the condition' to defeat Lula in the 2026 elections, citing polls showing the incumbent president ahead. Caiado positions himself as a viable right-wing alternative, stating he is either tied or within the margin of error against Lula in second-round scenarios, according to Nexus/BTG Pactual and Real Time Big Data polls. He also criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro for his ties to former banker Daniel Vorcaro, demanding explanations regarding an alleged R$134 million financial contribution to the senator’s political project.

item.title: Entenda o julgamento de Eduardo Bolsonaro no STF que começa nesta terça-feira
item.description: The First Chamber of the STF begins ruling this Tuesday on the criminal case against former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro, accused of acting in the United States to pressure Brazilian authorities and influence the progress of investigations related to the post-2022 election coup attempt. The case involves allegations of obstruction of justice and attempts to interfere with probes into the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Ala do STF se prepara para atuar como revisora do TSE nas eleições, e Kassio tenta marcar posição
item.description: A group of STF ministers is preparing to act as a reviewing body for TSE decisions in the 2026 elections, creating friction with Kassio Nunes Marques' leadership. The move aims to counterbalance electoral court rulings, as Kassio seeks to position himself amid the institutional crisis.

item.title: STF começa a julgar Eduardo Bolsonaro sob risco de novo atrito com EUA
item.description: The STF begins the criminal trial against Eduardo Bolsonaro, accused of acting in the U.S. to intimidate the Brazilian Judiciary. The First Chamber has a tendency to convict the lawmaker, which could spark a new diplomatic rift with the United States.

item.title: Campanha de Lula prioriza regulamentação das redes em vez de proibição para menores de 16 anos
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign prioritizes regulating social media for users under 16, choosing to assess the impact of the newly implemented ECA Digital before proposing new measures. The strategy avoids direct bans in favor of evidence-based regulatory solutions. This reflects a cautious, technical approach to addressing youth digital environment concerns.

item.title: Lula declara apoio a João Campos ao governo de Pernambuco
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared his support for former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) in the 2026 Pernambuco gubernatorial election, ruling out a dual slate with incumbent governor Raquel Lyra (PSD). The announcement was made in a video shared by Campos on social media, following a conversation with PT national president Edinho Silva, who rejected the idea of two slates in the state. Minister Wellington Dias had previously suggested a dual slate, which upset Campos.

item.title: Lula apoiará adversário de pai de Motta ao Senado pela Paraíba
item.description: President Lula declared his support for the re-election of Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo (MDB-PB) for the Senate in Paraíba, emphasizing their long-standing and honest partnership. He ruled out supporting Nabor Wanderley (Republicanos), father of Chamber President Hugo Motta, despite earlier expectations. Nabor’s office denied any withdrawal, stating he remains a strong pre-candidate.

item.title: Frente parlamentar e delegados repudiam fala de Lula sobre delegacias e celulares roubados
item.description: The Parliamentary Front for Public Security and the Adepol repudiated President Lula's statements regarding police station safety and the association of stolen phone buyers with low-income populations, calling them unjust generalizations and prejudiced remarks that undermine trust in law enforcement institutions.

item.title: Fachin mantém decisão de Dino, e Roraima segue com candidato único
item.description: Supreme Court President Luiz Edson Fachin denied the PL's request to suspend Justice Flávio Dino's decision reinstating the requirement for public officials to resign 3, 4, or 6 months before running in Roraima's supplementary elections. As a result, interim governor Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) remains the only viable candidate, while Boa Vista mayor Arthur Henrique (PL-RR) and Antônia Pedrosa (PT-RR) are barred for failing to resign in time. The ruling upholds STF precedent that the Court president cannot overturn another minister's injunction and that only the Public Prosecutor or public entities may seek suspension with proven public interest.

item.title: Fachin nega recurso do PL e mantém decisão de Dino sobre eleição em RR
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin denied a PL appeal and upheld Minister Flávio Dino's ruling that set deadlines for disengagement from public office ahead of the Roraima gubernatorial election in a caretaker term. The decision maintains the requirement for candidates to resign from public positions before the 2026 election.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro 'perdeu a condição de poder ganhar a eleição de Lula', diz Ronaldo Caiado sobre disputa pela Presidência
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has lost the condition to defeat Lula (PT) in a potential runoff, citing polls showing declining support for the senator. He positioned himself as the candidate with the best chance to beat Lula, noting that his own poll numbers show either a tie or within the margin of error, while Flávio Bolsonaro trails significantly. Caiado also refused to pre-judge Flávio Bolsonaro’s ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, insisting that individuals must answer for their own actions.

item.title: Novo-SC desconvida Zema de encontro estadual e ameaça se opor à candidatura
item.description: The Santa Catarina state directory of the Novo Party withdrew the invitation to presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema for the party's 7th State Meeting, scheduled for July 4 in Joinville. The decision followed Zema's criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro's association with banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating it would be difficult to applaud someone who associates with 'Brazil's biggest criminal banker'. The directory threatened to oppose Zema's candidacy unless there is a 'drastic and immediate change' in his campaign's communications team.
